title: 3.1.7c Lab — Rotate on Y
description: Spin a Cube on the Y axis by incrementing rotation.y each frame in draw().

steps.title: Create a Cube
steps.instructions: In setup(), write `cube = new Cube(0, 0, 0)` to place it at the origin.
hints: Give it a color too — a colored cube shows rotation more clearly than a white one.

steps.title: Spin on Y in draw()
steps.instructions: In draw(), write `cube.rotation.y += 0.01` to spin the cube a little each frame.
hints: 0.01 radians per frame is about 0.6 degrees per frame — a gentle spin. Try larger values to spin faster.

requirements.title: rotation.y is incremented
requirements.description: cube.rotation.y is incremented with += in draw().
